heading: Rule 3 — `dynamic_ttl: true` reintroduces a log factor
text:
### Rule 3 — `dynamic_ttl: true` reintroduces a log factor [LCAP.3.3]

`dynamic_ttl: false` keeps the per-schema FIFO TTL queue, so the TTL tick
is O(expired × log n_ttl_schemas + n_ttl_schemas) whatever
`linear_scan` is ([LCAP.2.4], [LDTL.6.1]). Its log factor is in the number of
TTL schemas, which is fixed at compile time, so no term grows with N_ttl.

`dynamic_ttl: true` replaces the FIFO queue with a deadline heap: the TTL
tick becomes O(expired × log N_ttl), which grows with N_ttl.

The combination of `linear_scan: false` and `dynamic_ttl: true` is permitted.
Its TTL tick and its asserts, each O(log N_ttl) on the heap ([LCAP.2.4]), are
the operations [LCAP.2.2]'s O(1) bound does not cover. What the combination
costs `realtime`'s T_wcet is [LCAP.3.9]'s.
